title: 英文面试模拟
summary: 从自我介绍到反问环节走一遍，考完给四项维度参考分。

stages.title: 开场 · 自我介绍
stages.instructions: 用一分钟介绍自己（50 词以上），说清现在做什么、擅长什么。
prompts: Thanks for coming in. Could you start by telling me a bit about yourself and what you do now?

stages.title: 经历 · STAR 式回答
stages.instructions: 每问 40 词以上，按「情境 → 做法 → 结果」讲，别只讲职责。
prompts: Tell me about a project you are proud of. What was your role?
Describe a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you handle it?
What is the hardest problem you have solved so far, and how?

stages.title: 收尾 · 反问环节
stages.instructions: 问一个你真正关心的关于团队或成长的问题（20 词以上）。
prompts: That's all from me. What would you like to ask us?
